name: Laundry Room of Emigrating Socks
description: A steamy sub-basement where the castle's laundry happens and every dryer is a portal with a customs office.
environment_gags: The lost-and-found board has one sock pinned to it, labeled 'IN MEMORIAM (THE LEFT ONE)'.
The lint trap is labeled 'TOLL BOOTH'.
A sign reads: 'The dryer takes 10%. It always has.'

jokes.setup: Why does the castle never actually lose a sock?
jokes.punchline: Sock Gremlin: 'Lose? Nothing is lost. They EMIGRATE. I stamp the paperwork myself.'

jokes.setup: Ask Sock Gremlin where all the left socks go.
jokes.punchline: Sock Gremlin: 'Same place your pen goes. We have a whole economy, and frankly it's thriving.'

jokes.setup: Tomorrow Bot is asked to fold the towels.
jokes.punchline: Tomorrow Bot: 'Tomorrow.' It has said this every single day since the castle was built. In its defense, it has never once been technically wrong.

jokes.setup: Why is the laundry always warm?
jokes.punchline: Sock Gremlin: 'Ambient guilt. Every I'll-do-it-tomorrow in this castle ends up down here, and those things hold heat for YEARS.'

interactions: File a missing-sock report. Expect it stamped, notarized, and politely denied.
Ask Tomorrow Bot if it's free today. (It isn't. Ask again tomorrow.)
Attempt to catch a sock mid-emigration through the dryer portal.
